source_text: 30 秒短片：进入阅读角、翻开书、停在灯光下；不含真实人物、品牌或未授权音乐。

inputs.action_principles: draws, slashes, blocks, slips, counters, sheaths, pursuit; fast and stylish
inputs.audio_design: synced steel, cloth, footwork, stone, dust, banners, breath; no dialogue
inputs.camera_language: FPV close orbit, low orbit, rear-side cut, ground skim, thread between fighters, spiral on clash
inputs.camera_motion_rules: fast but readable; never chaotic flying; short impact shake aligned with force
inputs.character_dynamics: A presses with continuous pursuit; B is precise, defensive, stylish, suppressed but unbeaten
inputs.clash_vfx: sparks, transparent shock rings, black and cold-white tearing, stone burst, banner rip, dust wave
inputs.dual_consistency_lock: strictly inherit first-frame faces, bodies, wardrobe; never swap identities
inputs.ending_directive: B almost kneels then recovers; A stands with advantage; FPV pull-back to unresolved standoff
inputs.environment_destruction: tiles crack, pillars split, beams burst, banners tear, stones fly, dust waves with mass
inputs.fight_arc: A opens aggressive, B is forced onto defense, B's one stylish counter is broken, unresolved standoff
inputs.fight_beats: 0–3 秒站位试探；3–7 秒一次格挡；7–10 秒退步拉开距离；没有伤口特写
inputs.fighter_a_identity: 虚构成年训练者 A，深蓝训练服，左手持软质短刀
inputs.fighter_a_vfx: black ink-wind afterimages, dark-grey torn air, thread-like blade qi, black-feather debris
inputs.fighter_b_identity: 虚构成年训练者 B，灰色训练服，右手持软质长刀
inputs.fighter_b_vfx: cold-white vacuum cuts, silver transparent arcs, thin air-slash lines, faint white afterimages
inputs.final_feel: high-end action demo: fast, stylish, VFX-heavy, readable, cinematic not cheap xianxia glow
inputs.lighting_palette: hard-edge sunlight through broken roofs, volumetric dust, cold metal highlights
inputs.negative_prompts: no sluggish motion, standing duels, front-face holds, magic orbs, laser cannons, knockout, gore, scene change
inputs.quality_profile: UE5-level lighting, PBR materials, fine cloth hair dust stone and metal sparks
inputs.scenario_summary: 成年访客走进虚构阅读角，翻开书，停在窗边灯光下
inputs.scene_desc: 虚构训练庭院，平整地面、石墙和一个木门，无围观人群
inputs.scene_layout: 两人相距两米沿东西轴站立，木门位于北侧，镜头留在南侧
inputs.style_reference: fast close-range high-pressure action-demo temperament; inherit lens language only
inputs.vfx_binding_rules: every important cut binds aura to blade path, body rotation, footwork, clash, and debris

output.example: 合成内容示例（供理解输出方向，未运行模型）：镜头方案候选：0–8 秒进入阅读角，8–20 秒翻书并展示环境，20–30 秒停留灯下。声音和身份连续性需逐镜核对；没有实际视频产物。

review_checks: 核对所有事实能在输入资料或已接受引用中找到。
核对输出满足 Compile first-frame lock, dual blade-VFX palettes, FPV-orbit camera, readable sword choreography, and a suppression-without-defeat arc into a duel prompt for direct video-model delivery
缺失或未确认信息必须明确标注；不得新增授权、执行或生产完成声明。
